# terrakube_notification_configuration (Data Source)

Look up a single notification configuration by name, within an organization and (optionally) a specific workspace. If `workspace_id` is omitted, looks up the organization-wide default; if set, looks up that workspace's override.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "terrakube_notification_configuration" "prod_alerts" {
  organization_id = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  name            = "prod-alerts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification configuration name
- `organization_id` (String) Terrakube organization id

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) Terrakube workspace id. Omit to look up an organization-wide default; set to look up a workspace-level override.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether this configuration is enabled
- `channel_type` (String) Delivery channel: `SLACK`, `TEAMS`, or `WEBHOOK`.
- `description` (String) Notification configuration description
- `destination_url` (String) Destination URL for the channel
- `id` (String) Notification configuration ID
- `message_style` (String) Notification message format: `DETAILED` or `SIMPLE`
- `template_ids` (List of String) Template IDs this configuration is narrowed to. Empty means it applies to every template.
- `trigger_statuses` (List of String) Job statuses that trigger this notification
